title.zh: 使甲米地省财政员兼任地区工程师、并让该省审计员与地区卫生官担任Trece Martires市议会当然成员，为此修订该市宪章第5条的法案
title.en: An Act Making the Provincial Treasurer the District Engineer, the Provincial Auditor and the District Health Officer of the Province of Cavite Ex Officio Members of the City Council of the City of Trece Martires, Amending for the Purpose Section Five of the Charter of Said City
title.orig: An Act Making the Provincial Treasurer the District Engineer, the Provincial Auditor and the District Health Officer of the Province of Cavite Ex Officio Members of the City Council of the City of Trece Martires, Amending for the Purpose Section Five of the Charter of Said City

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1913_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The second paragraph of section five of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred eighty-one, otherwise known as the Charter of the City of Trece Martires, is amended to read as follows:
"The Provincial Governor, members of the provincial board, the district engineer, the provincial treasurer, the provincial fiscal, and the district health officer of the Province of Cavite, shall be ex officio, City Mayor, members of the City Council, city engineer, city treasurer-assessor, city fiscal and city health officer of the city, respectively. Said provincial treasurer, district engineer and district health officer and the provincial auditor shall also be ex officio members of the City Council."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
